verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs do include an API reference section, covering custom integration push APIs (integration monitoring) and Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples. A probe also found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at the common paths, which usually backs a try-it console. Missing for 10: interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration of the API reference experience.
